mentions.name: Hourly news website screenshot tracker
mentions.description: This app automatically takes a screenshot every hour of several news websites, running as a small Python script on a Raspberry Pi 5 with the images saved locally. A front-end is planned for visually exploring how each site's landing page top changes over the course of a day.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an app that takes a screenshot every hour from some news websites. It's is a small python script running on my raspberry pi 5 and for now I'm saving the images there. I'm planning to build a front-end app to explorer how each website changes over the course of a day, focusing only on the top of the landing page.
